Profile Sulglicotide is a sulfated glycopeptide with cytoprotective prop- erties extracted from pig duodenum. It is used in the treatment of peptic ulcer disease (p.1702) and other gastrointestinal disorders in a usual oral dose of 200 mg three times daily.
